```java title="Java"

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<img src=\"chart.png\" alt=\"Sales chart\" title=\"Q3 Sales\">", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);

}
```
